name: The Clash

whyMatters.en: London punk band, 1976–1986. With Sex Pistols they mark early UK punk; London Calling and Combat Rock widen the writing into reggae and rockabilly.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦朋克乐队，1976–1986。与 Sex Pistols 同为早期英国朋克代表；《London Calling》与《Combat Rock》把写法扩到雷鬼与 rockabilly。

essentialTracks.title: Should I Stay or Should I Go

note.en: Title track of the 1979 double album; Strummer vocal, Jones guitar, Headon drums.
note.zh: 1979 双专同名曲；Strummer 人声、Jones 吉他、Headon 鼓。

scenes.track: Should I Stay or Should I Go

note.en: Combat Rock track; simple chord cycle and gang vocal; later radio staple.
note.zh: 出自《Combat Rock》；简单和弦循环与群吼；后来成为电台常播。

interviewQuotes.text: We're a garage band that learned the world was bigger than garage.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Mick Jones

lyricQuotes: London calling to the faraway towns
Should I stay or should I go?

shortBio.en: London punk, 1976–86. Strummer and Jones writing; London Calling and Combat Rock are the main references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦朋克，1976–86。Strummer 与 Jones 写作；《London Calling》与《Combat Rock》是主要参照。

body.en: London punk band, 1976–1986. Bernie Rhodes brought Paul Simonon to Mick Jones and recruited Joe Strummer from The 101’ers. Early support slots for Sex Pistols; Keith Levene soon left and later joined Public Image Ltd. Topper Headon settled the classic drums seat. London Calling (1979, Guy Stevens) and Combat Rock (1982) are the widest-heard albums.
body.zh: 伦敦朋克乐队，1976–1986。Bernie Rhodes 把 Paul Simonon 带到 Mick Jones 身边，并请来 The 101’ers 的 Joe Strummer。早期为 Sex Pistols 暖场；Keith Levene 很快离队，后加入 Public Image Ltd。Topper Headon 固定鼓位。《London Calling》（1979，Guy Stevens 制作）与《Combat Rock》（1982）是流传最广的专辑。

body.en:
Pete Townshend is quoted in the book: hearing The Clash felt like hearing life, and getting strength to face it.

1976 UK punk made Clash and Sex Pistols the two best-known names.
body.zh:
书中引 Pete Townshend：听 The Clash 像听到人生，并得到面对人生的力量。

1976 年英国朋克里，Clash 与 Sex Pistols 是最知名的两支。

body.en:
The 1979 double album opens with the title track: Strummer vocal, Jones guitar, Headon drums.

It is the clearest public entry to the band’s expanded writing.
body.zh:
1979 双专以同名曲开场：Strummer 人声、Jones 吉他、Headon 鼓。

它是接触乐队扩展写法的最清楚入口。

title.en: Should I Stay or Should I Go
title.zh: 《Should I Stay or Should I Go》

body.en: Combat Rock (1982) became the biggest seller, with Rock the Casbah and Should I Stay or Should I Go—the latter the band’s only US #1 single. Jones said the song concerned his relationship with Ellen Foley.
body.zh: 《Combat Rock》（1982）成为销量最高的专辑，含《Rock the Casbah》与《Should I Stay or Should I Go》——后者是乐队唯一美国冠军单曲。Jones 说这首歌与他和 Ellen Foley 的感情有关。

body.en:
Strummer came from The 101’ers. Levene’s exit path led to Public Image Ltd with Lydon.

Pearlman (Blue Öyster Cult) and Stevens (Mott the Hoople) mark the late-1970s studio steps. After Headon’s firing and Jones’s exit, the late lineup cut Cut the Crap and stopped in 1986. Strummer died in 2002.
body.zh:
Strummer 来自 The 101’ers。Levene 离队后与 Lydon 进入 Public Image Ltd。

Pearlman（Blue Öyster Cult）与 Stevens（Mott the Hoople）对应 1970 年代末的制作节点。Headon 被解雇、Jones 离队后，晚期阵容录制《Cut the Crap》，1986 年停止。Strummer 于 2002 年去世。

body.en:
Strummer’s later line “The future is unwritten” and Jones’s garage-band remarks sit beside the lyric reportage.

Check them against the records’ stylistic spread from debut punk to Combat Rock.
body.zh:
Strummer 后来的「The future is unwritten」与 Jones 关于 garage band 的说法，可与歌词报道对照。

对照唱片从首专朋克到《Combat Rock》的风格跨度。

note.en: Title track of the 1979 double album; key public reference.
note.zh: 1979 双专同名曲；主要公众参照。

note.en: Reggae and rockabilly inside three-chord punk writing.
note.zh: 在三和弦朋克写法中加入雷鬼与 rockabilly。

note.en: Levene was dismissed early; he later joined John Lydon’s Public Image Ltd. Chimes disliked spit-and-bottle gigs; Rob Harper briefly covered drums before Chimes returned for the debut LP, then Headon took over.
note.zh: Levene 早期被解雇，后加入 John Lydon 的 Public Image Ltd。Chimes 不喜欢吐痰扔瓶子的现场；Rob Harper 短暂顶鼓，首张 LP 时 Chimes 又回来帮忙，随后由 Headon 接任。

note.en: Give ’Em Enough Rope: Sandy Pearlman (Blue Öyster Cult). London Calling: Guy Stevens (early Mott the Hoople). Headon fired April 1982 over heroin; Chimes returned for Combat Rock.
note.zh: 《Give ’Em Enough Rope》由 Sandy Pearlman（Blue Öyster Cult）制作。《London Calling》由 Guy Stevens（Mott the Hoople 早期）制作。1982 年 4 月 Headon 因海洛因被解雇；Chimes 回归参与《Combat Rock》。

note.en: Jones left 1983 → General Public, then Big Audio Dynamite. Cut the Crap (1985) was the last studio album; the band dissolved in 1986.
note.zh: Jones 于 1983 年离队，先后加入 General Public、成立 Big Audio Dynamite。《Cut the Crap》（1985）是最后一张录音室专辑；1986 年解散。
